thread:
noah: Brain dump: "edge vouchers" + safety-leash for local admit. Trying to avoid double-credit and keep reconciliation simple. Want quick opinions before an RFC.

anya: high level please?

noah: idea: central ledger issues short-lived vouchers to regions. proxy admits optimistically against voucher balance. vouchers are small (e.g., 50-200 units) and expire fast (10-30s). on reconcile, central subtracts actual usage. if local over-admits, proxy reduces admit window exponentially.

leo: why vouchers vs local counters syncing frequently?

noah: vouchers make reconciliation simple and bounded: you only reconcile used vouchers, not every single request. avoids high-cardinality deltas. also clear audit trail (voucher id -> usage).

anya: sketch a voucher API?

noah: short sketch:
```yaml
POST /ledger/v1/vouchers/allocate
body:
  tenant_id: T123
  region: us-west-2
  want_units: 100
response:
  voucher_id: vch_abc
  units: 80
  ttl_seconds: 20
```

leo: what are units? tokens? rps? hybrid?

noah: units are abstract credits tied to a tenant profile. conversion = tenant_weights.tokens*token_count + tenant_weights.cpu_ms*cpu_ms + tenant_weights.requests*1. Central defines conversion per tenant.

anya: abuse vector: tenant sending to multiple regions to double-spend vouchers.

noah: mitigation: each voucher has tenant+region binding and an anti-duplication header check. central refuses allocate if suspicious pattern (same client IP across regions). plus reconciliation dedup by request fingerprint.

leo: fingerprinting might be noisy with NATs.

noah: agreed. fallback: if cross-region dedup heuristic triggers, edge proxies enter coordinated-strict mode: they stop optimistic admits and require explicit voucher attach with proof-of-origin.

anya: how does reconciliation work? cadence and contract?

noah: proxies emit usage blobs every 5-10s. reconciler reduces central voucher units by sum(usage). if sum > allocated for voucher -> mark voucher overdraft and emit penalty signal. policy: mild overdraft allowed up to 10% then apply local throttle.

leo: penalty path? sliding backoff?

noah: yes: overdraft->exponential backoff factor f(t)=base * 2^k where k increments per overdraft in window. also apply temporary penalty scores to tenant that feed into admission decisions central+local.

anya: what about cheap request flooding to exhaust vouchers?

noah: proxies track per-client compact histograms (request size, latency, token_estimate). cheap floods detected via low-cost-high-rate pattern -> mark client hot and reduce its share of voucher consumption. also require per-client micro-vouchers drawn from tenant voucher to limit blast radius.

leo: telemetry checklist?

noah: required metrics before rollout:
- voucher_alloc_rate{tenant,region}
- voucher_overdraft_count{tenant,region}
- local_admit_vs_voucher{tenant,region}
- client_hot_markers_count{tenant,client}
- fallback_enforced_count{tenant,region,mode}
- reconcile_latency_seconds

anya: rollout plan?

noah: phased:
1) emit-only: edge proxies request vouchers but do not enforce; collect metrics 72h.
2) shadow-enforce: proxy simulates enforcement and logs divergences for 48h.
3) canary region: small % enforcement for internal tenants only.
4) opt-in beta for customers.
5) gradual global ramp with SLO gate.

leo: SLOs?

noah: propose: false-positive fallback <0.3% on beta tenants; reconcile_gap99 < 5% for first month; rollout abort if customer errors spike >2x baseline.

anya: ops tooling? kill-switch?

noah: yes: /admin/edge-proxy/{region}/mode -> [simulate,shadow,enforce,off]. global emergency off and per-tenant throttle override. also quick recon job to force-sync vouchers.

dev-ops-bot: Runbook created: "edge-voucher-emergency-disable". Actions: 1) set /admin feature to off, 2) run voucher-reconcile-manual for region, 3) notify #incidents and #support, 4) patch customer-facing telemetry.

leo: perf cost? extra reconciler and voucher service. estimate ~2 small pods each region + 1 reconcile worker fleet.

anya: docs: make the admission policy tiny and auditable. prefer 5 boolean toggles rather than huge DSL.

noah: agreed. i'll draft RFC covering: voucher API, reconcile contract, client micro-vouchers, abuse heuristics, telemetry dashboards, and rollout checklist. aiming to post next Wednesday.

leo: ping me for ops review.

anya: i'll take abuse heuristics tuning. good start.
